notablePrerequisites: Marwyn does not have summoning sickness and has a power of eight or greater.
description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Cast Vitalize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
